name: Lloyds Luxuries Ltd.
summary: Luxury retail and grooming service provider holding exclusive master franchise rights for Truefitt & Hill (high-end male grooming services and luxury products) and Mary Cohr (French women's skincare and beauty treatments). Operates through franchised and company-owned stores targeting upscale clientele across India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Vietnam, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. Revenue generated from both services and retail of luxury personal care products.
